Officer '''Sidney''' was a member of the [[Lewisburg]] Police Department before the [[Great War]].

==Background==
While investigating the disappearance of [[Aries|Calvin van Lowe]] with his partner [[Cavit Klein|Officer Cavit Klein]], he was killed by one of Van Lowe's contacts with the [[Bysshe Company]], [[Big Bad Wolf]].<ref>[[Klein's notes]]</ref>

==Appearances==
Sidney's [[Skeleton (Fallout 76)|skeleton]] appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]'', introduced in the ''[[Wild Appalachia]]'' [[Fallout 76 updates|update]].
